title: Leaderboard
subtitle: Learning points ranking for employees and teams

myScore.title: My Score
myScore.notRanked: Your account isn't linked to an active employee record, so it isn't ranked yet.

how.intro: Points come from this year's activity and have no cap: the more you do, the more you earn. The ranking follows total points, and the label (Excellent/Good/Fair) follows where your rank falls: top 10%, 25% and 50%.
how.reading: Reading Log: per finished book (Approved or not yet claimed for the incentive). Non-fiction 10, business comics 5, fiction/magazines 3. Books rejected by HR or cancelled don't count.
how.module: Online Module: per course with every module completed, points = post-test score ÷ 10 (8 without a post-test).
how.internal: Internal Training: per closed session you attended. Points = post-test score ÷ 10; without your own post-test, the session average, or 8 if the session has no post-test.
how.host: Training Host: per session you host, points = the attendees' average post-test ÷ 10 (8 without a post-test).
how.external: External Training: 10 points per training Processed (paid) by HR.
how.leader: Leaders only, per team task: monthly IDP review ±1, competency assessment per member per quarter ±2, and Post Training Evaluation per attendee ±1 — points are added when done and taken off when missed. The month or quarter in progress counts only once done.
how.team: Team score = the average points of the leader and their direct reports, so a bigger team doesn't win by size alone.
